title: Releases page: a green check or red X at the start of each release, and of each check
why: Jason, 2026-11-18: 'make each line easier to see if it passed or failed. so green check box or red x at the beginning of the title.' Each release's line on System Configuration → Releases now starts with a mark in a small box, as the Pre-flight's: green check when its checks passed or it's live, red X when a check failed, it withdrew itself or it's paused, grey dash when it hasn't been checked yet or a person withdrew it. Each check line in its folded checks has the same mark. Only the Releases section of app/admin/sections.php changes. FAQ: the Releases entry says so.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs
